name: Andorra: self-employed
dueNote: IGI returns are quarterly or half-yearly. Personal income tax (IRPF) is settled yearly; the rest of a year's reserve is released after 31 July.
notes: General IGI rate 4.5%; IRPF ranges from 0% to 10%. Self-employed social security (CASS) is not included.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
